notes.title: City Builder & Colony Sim Fest
notes.content:
We’re excited to be part of this week’s [b]City Builder & Colony Sim Fest[/b] on Steam.

Happy to share some behind-the-scenes insights from the development of The Lumenites. A cozy, non-violent village builder on a flying turtle.

If you love the way it feels, don’t forget to [u][b]wishlist [/b][/u]it! 💛

Whats new?

[list]
[*]New Main Character, somehow with a frog companion perched on their head?
[*]Added a Desert, a warm, cozy atmosphere by night
[/list]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44733515/4a1b3efda00814c2a3a024d6f4d35ee0e7104541.png[/img]

notes.title: A love letter to the community
notes.content:
Dear all,

It's crazy, and we feel incredibly blessed to be part of "[u][b]Wholesome Games[/b][/u]" this year. Even though our role may be small, [b]it means the world to us as indie developers[/b]. 

[i][b]We might look slow and steady like a turtle, but when it comes to this awesome cozy and wholesome community, we're happily hopping around like a hare![/b][/i] 🐢


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44733515/63210c3a6a472afcfe610ac5d4d6b29d5371ebff.png[/img]

Many thanks, our community is turtley awesome!

 - Simon

notes.title: 🌅 20 layers of parallax with a cozy atmosphere...
notes.content:
We've made significant progress in the past few weeks with several exciting updates. We not only want to update the screenshots, but also give you some background information.

[h3][b]Enhanced Dialogues[/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44733515/af7236eeccbf46dbbeef65b7d55681fbc8697e38.png[/img]
Get to know the unique visuals and surprising character of our gentle turtle


[h3][b]Seamless Island Landing[/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44733515/dd4758377193d3481bbf5a622dc9300296155ffa.png[/img]
Explore your islands without any loading screens, maintaining a seamless and cozy exploration of the skies.


[h3][b]Improved Building System[/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44733515/ab5e7c7ff418f9974c825cf63ca140b1d449f018.png[/img]
Based on player feedback, we are refining our building system to provide clearer guidelines for placement, ensuring a more intuitive building experience.


[h3][b]Enhanced Visual Depth[/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44733515/2e93d78eeb51defba6fb5db18c7fb76a33aa5daa.png[/img]
With 20 layers of images, we’ve enhanced the realism of the island, creating a more immersive environment.

We hope you enjoy these updates, 

🐢, Simon

notes.title: 🐢 30-frame Turtle animation in pixel art 🐢
notes.content:
Our game is inspired by nature, so we decided to use footage of a real turtle swimming underwater.

Let me share some[b] inside footage[/b] of that process...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44733515/5c61efacbbf34fd99608988cc20f250f1cd01682.gif[/img]


Here’s how we did it step-by-step:
[list]
[*] Extract 40 frames video footage via ffmpeg
[*] make colored markers on key points of the turtle
[*] stabilize and adjust the image
[*] draw the outlines for your turtle
[*] colorize it 🐢
[/list]


here is the result of this 30 frame animation in pixel art:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44733515/3a4d21f63dbf9e11f5b4dbf394ef0fd6ee1b3aa2.gif[/img]
